results.title: 'Golden Boy' Neeraj can sometimes get silver too, he is human after all: Sumariwalla
results.description: The two-time Olympic medal-winning javelin thrower, who has been troubled by a lower back injury for nearly a year, produced a season's best effort of 86.48m to win silver at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last month. He had collected a gold at the same event in 2018 before being forced to miss the 2022 edition due to injury.
